behaviors.description: Transfer app and runtime through custom USB destination repository.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent signed collection-ID repository and fresh offline destination user installation.
behaviors.expected: Custom repo and discovery symlink exist; with origin URL unavailable destination installs exact app/runtime commits from USB.

mappings.rationale: Fresh destination installation with unavailable origin installs both exact signed commits using target-created USB repo. User/app flags are not credited without competing candidates.

surface_assertions.rationale: Payload created under selected path with resolving discovery symlink.
